task: Incremental build engine (ae.build) with dynamic deps, early cutoff, CRC-sealed persistent store
reasoning_summary: Rules record the dependencies they actually need while running; a stored record is reused when every recorded dep (checked in order) still has the same value hash, and an unchanged rerun value cuts off dependents. Failures are memoised per run and never overwrite old records; the store is canonical, CRC32-sealed and written atomically. Tests combine literal scenarios, exhaustive corruption loops and a seeded incremental-vs-scratch differential test.
